errors.text_span: ABLC 为灰色实线，使用三角形标记，从 0 组约 0.93 下降到
errors.evidence: The description states the initial F1 value for the ABLC series is approximately 0.93. However, in the chart, the ABLC line (gray, triangle) starts at approximately 0.95 at x=0, which is the highest point on the chart, visually identical to the starting point of the BLAC series. The stated value of 0.93 is incorrect and also misrepresents the relative performance of the models, as it implies ABLC starts lower than BLAC.

The description uses commas as decimal separators for the x-axis tick labels (e.g., "1,2", "3,7"), whereas the image uses periods (e.g., "1.2", "3.7"). This error is repeated throughout the description when referring to these data points.
